description: openEMS: the C45 via pair of the default setup (0.5/0.22 at pitch 0.7, pads on L1 and L6 only, stadium antipad 1.22 x 1.92 on L2 and L5, six return vias 0.4/0.2), 50R_SE feeds of both barrels on L1 toward -x and on L6 toward +x, default stackup JLC061611-3313A with masks

structure.frame: first barrel at x = y = 0 (the pair's second at y = 0.7); z up from the outer face of L6's copper

via.barrel: solid PEC cylinder of the drill diameter from z = 0 to 1.637

domain.note: planes, laminate and masks run into the PML on the four sides

openems.interface: Python 3.14 wheels of the release, venv C:\Users\Jonat\opt\openEMS-venv
openems.engine: default (multithreaded), material averaging on, lossless here

mesh.pml: 8-cell PML inside the domain on every open side
mesh.notes: x, y: at most 0.0367 (6 cells per drill) over the via block (pads, antipads, returns, backdrill), graded 1.3 to 0.15; a line within 15 um of a more important one left out (sym_lines merge); y: thirds rule at the feed edges (0.01 inside, 0.02 outside); z: lines on every copper and dielectric face and on the masks over copper, 4 cells in the 0.092 prepregs, at most 0.05 in the board, graded to 0.2 in the air; every axis mirror-symmetric about the structure's centre (x = 0, y = 0.35, z = 0.8185); no line on the mask over laminate (4.5 um from the copper face; material averaging)
mesh.barrels: staircase (openEMS default, no conformal option): 6 cells per drill, lines on the drill edges; pads, antipads, return vias and the backdrill on lines at their edges where they cross the axes, staircased elsewhere

excitation.source: openEMS LumpedPort (R 50 ohm, soft E source in its edges), one run per excited port

ports.name: A1
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = -4.5, y = 0; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

ports.name: B1
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = -4.5, y = 0.7; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

ports.name: A6
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = 4.5, y = 0; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

ports.name: B6
ports.kind: lumped port R 50 ohm at x = 4.5, y = 0.7; waves from a probe plane (voltage at 3 x lines, current loop around the whole copper section)

mixedMode.how: Sdd = (S of A minus S of B)/2 etc. with the pairs (A1, B1) on L1 and (A6, B6) on L6: Sdd11 = S11 - S21, Sdd21 = S31 - S41, Scc11 = S11 + S21, Scc21 = S31 + S41

tdr.time: round trip, 0 = 50 % of the edge at the reference plane

sParameters.how: two runs (ports A1 and B6); S_ij = p[i xor j] by the two mirror symmetries (y about the pair's centre line, and the 180 degree rotation about the y axis that maps L1 onto L6), least squares over both runs (common.fit_s); stored: the first column, the rest by the pattern
sParameters.referencePlanes: the ports' x below (3 mm feeds included, not de-embedded)

feeds.how: each probe plane's Z = sqrt(E dE / (H dH)) and beta (from the run where its signal is largest)

sanity.feedsVs2DNote: the 2D solver (lines.ts) on the trapezoid (base 0.1377, top 0.11992) with its mask; openEMS has the rectangle of the mean width; bars |dz| <= 4 % (openEMS reads the feeds about 3.4 % high on this mesh, 27 um cells across the trace by the thirds rule; msl-c39 at 15 um read 1.45 % low), |deeff| <= 3 %

provenance.postProcessedAgain: from the same run's probe files (--post): S, lines and sanity re-made by the scripts named
